📢 Important: Affiliate Program Guidelines & Policies

We’re excited to have you as part of our affiliate program! To ensure smooth collaboration and fair play for everyone involved, please take a moment to review our official Affiliate Policies & Guidelines below.


🔹 General Policies


Affiliates must comply with all local laws and advertising guidelines.

Misleading claims or false advertising are strictly prohibited.


🚫 No Brand Bidding


Bidding on our brand name, domain name, or variations/misspellings in paid ads (e.g., Google Ads, Meta Ads, Bing, etc.) is strictly prohibited.

Violations may result in immediate account termination and forfeiture of pending commissions.


💳 Payment Method


Payments are issued via [PayPal/Venmo].

Minimum payout threshold: $15.

Payments are processed on a monthly basis (10th of every month).


✅ Affiliate Verification


Each affiliate account must be verified before receiving payments.

Verification requires submission of valid ID and traffic source details.


💡 Accepted Traffic Sources


Allowed: Social media, blogs, websites, email lists (opt-in only), influencer traffic, and organic methods.

Prohibited: Incentivized clicks, bots, spam, adult, or misleading traffic.


Always ensure traffic is real, relevant, and compliant with our policies.


💰 Refund & Chargeback Policy


Commissions are paid only for completed and non-refunded sales.

In case of chargebacks or customer refunds, the corresponding commission will be deducted from your next payout.


🧾 Reporting & Tracking


Real-time tracking and performance reports are available in your affiliate dashboard.

If you notice any discrepancies, contact us within 7 days of the transaction.


📩 Need Help?


If you have any questions about the policies or need assistance, feel free to reach out to our affiliate support team at support@neosabers.com


Thank you for being part of our growing affiliate network. Let’s work together to achieve amazing results!
